headline: Ledger Finds Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin, Probes Dubai Cases
coverage: Bitcoin and cryptocurrency hardware wallet supply-chain security; November 18 Ledger investigation update

dedup.editorial_distinction: New confirmed Berlin cases, unconfirmed Dubai investigations and one affected Nano Gen5 in Southeast Asia, November 18 official update

factual_distinctions.Germany: few confirmed modified devices in Berlin, buyers since January 2026 advised to contact support
factual_distinctions.Dubai: two reported devices under investigation, not confirmed to identical threshold
factual_distinctions.Ledger_technology: manufacturer reports no secure chip or OS flaw; no confirmed affected ledger.com-direct device
factual_distinctions.technical_mechanism: physical implant captures recovery phrase during setup
factual_distinctions.safety: Do not open suspect devices; contact Ledger official support; if funds at risk migrate to wallet with freshly generated secret; never reuse possibly exposed phrase

SmartChart.reason: No stable, independently established denominator or complete incident counts; a map or count chart could imply exhaustive geographic coverage or confirmed Dubai infections
